en.title: What is Archeris
en.excerpt: Learn how Archeris helps you run archery tournaments smoothly, from participant registration and field scoring to automated elimination brackets and verified certificates.

toc.text: 1. Why Modern Archery Needs Digital Precision

en.content:
On Archeris, you can manage every phase of an archery tournament in a single cloud platform. From opening online ticket registrations and allocating target butts to recording arrow scores directly at the shooting line, generating elimination brackets, and issuing verified electronic certificates, everything is connected in real time.

1. Why Modern Archery Needs Digital Precision

For decades, archery tournaments have relied on paper scorecards, clipboard tallying, complex spreadsheets, and long delays before leaderboard updates. Rain can ruin paper sheets, math errors delay match brackets, and spectators often have no way to follow the competition live.

Archeris replaces these manual bottlenecks with a clean, mobile-first web system built according to World Archery standards. Tournament organizers save hours of administrative work, scorekeepers can log arrow values with a few taps, and archers get an instant digital record of their competition performance.

Whether you are organizing a small club practice shoot, an inter-school championship, or a multi-day national open, the platform scales smoothly to match your field size and participant volume.

2. End-to-End Tournament Workflow

A tournament on Archeris progresses smoothly through five main stages:

  1. Tournament Setup & Ticketing: Configure divisions, entry fees, and quota limits per target.
  2. Target Butt Allocation: Place archers into target positions A, B, C, and D automatically or manually.
  3. Live Qualification Scoring: Field scorekeepers log arrows end by end right beside the target butt.
  4. Automated Elimination Engine: Generate seedings, set brackets, and shoot-offs automatically.
  5. Official Results & E-Certificates: Publish live leaderboards and verified certificates instantly.

Notice how data moves automatically between stages. Once the qualification round concludes, the elimination bracket engine reads the final ranking standings instantly without requiring organizers to manually calculate seedings or draw brackets by hand.

3. Platform User Roles & Access

Archeris connects all tournament participants into dedicated, role-specific workspaces:

  • Tournament Organizers: Create events, customize division categories, configure payment methods, manage target assignments, and monitor live competition progress from the organizer dashboard.
  • Archers & Athletes: Maintain a unified athlete portfolio, register for open tournaments with one click using saved profile data, view live target schedules, and download official competition certificates.
  • Club Managers & Coaches: Register multi-archer delegations in a single bulk checkout, track contingent payment statuses, and monitor athlete shooting statistics in real time.
  • Field Scorekeepers: Access mobile-optimized target butt scorecards using a short 5-character access code without installing any extra app.

Because each role has a tailored interface, field volunteers only see what they need to enter scores, while tournament directors maintain full control over event settings and financial reconciliation.

4. Traditional Tournaments vs Archeris

The table below summarizes the practical differences between running a tournament manually versus using the Archeris digital ecosystem:

Tournament Operation Traditional Manual Approach With Archeris Platform
Participant Registration Manual spreadsheets, WhatsApp chat receipts, bank mutation cross-checks Self-service online portal with automatic payment verification
Target Butt Allocation Complex manual Excel formulas prone to duplicate target numbers 1-click automated butt distribution with printable target lists
Score Recording Paper scorecards collected after rounds and retyped into computers Instant mobile keypad entry right beside the target butt
Elimination Brackets Hours spent calculating ties and drawing bracket trees on paper Instant bracket generation with World Archery seedings and byes
Publishing Results Paper printouts pinned to boards and certificates mailed weeks later Live online leaderboards and instant verifiable e-certificates

By automating repetitive scoring math and administrative tracking, tournament directors can focus their energy on venue logistics and creating a memorable experience for athletes.

5. Getting Started on Archeris

Starting with Archeris is straightforward and requires no upfront technical setup:

  1. If you are an Archer: Register a free account, complete your basic profile (bow division, shooting hand, club), and browse available tournaments on the public schedule.
  2. If you are a Tournament Organizer: Create an organizer account, complete your organization profile, and use the step-by-step tournament wizard to publish your first competition.

You can test all scoring and bracket features immediately to familiarize your team before competition day.

id.title: Mengenal Platform Archeris
id.excerpt: Panduan lengkap cara Archeris membantu Anda mengelola turnamen panahan dari pendaftaran peserta, input skor di lapangan, bagan eliminasi, sampai cetak e-sertifikat.

toc.text: 4. Beda Cara Manual vs Pakai Archeris

id.content:
Di Archeris, Anda bisa mengurus semua kebutuhan turnamen panahan di satu tempat. Anda tidak perlu lagi repot bolak-balik antara Google Form, file Excel, dan tumpukan kertas skor. Semuanya, mulai dari pendaftaran peserta, pembagian nomor bantalan, input skor di lapangan, bagan eliminasi, sampai bagi e-sertifikat, sudah berjalan otomatis di sistem cloud.

1. Mengapa Beralih ke Sistem Digital?

Kalau pernah bikin turnamen panahan pakai cara lama, Anda pasti tahu repotnya: kertas skor bisa basah kena hujan, panitia harus menghitung manual ratusan anak panah, dan bagan eliminasi butuh waktu berjam-jam untuk digambar. Peserta dan penonton pun harus menunggu lama cuma untuk tahu siapa yang lolos ke babak berikutnya.

Archeris hadir supaya Anda tidak perlu pusing dengan urusan teknis seperti itu. Skor dihitung otomatis sesuai aturan resmi World Archery dan Perpani, juri lapangan tinggal ketuk layar HP di samping bantalan, dan atlet bisa langsung melihat peringkat mereka detik itu juga.

Baik untuk latihan bersama di klub, kejuaraan sirkuit pelajar, maupun turnamen nasional terbuka, sistem Archeris siap dipakai sesuai jumlah peserta dan bantalan yang Anda siapkan.

2. Alur Turnamen di Archeris

Turnamen di Archeris berjalan rapi melalui lima tahapan utama:

  1. Buka Pendaftaran Turnamen: Atur kategori lomba, kuota bantalan sasaran, dan biaya tiket pendaftaran.
  2. Plotting Bantalan Sasaran: Bagi atlet ke posisi target A, B, C, dan D secara otomatis atau manual.
  3. Skoring Kualifikasi Lapangan: Petugas atau juri menginput nilai panah per rambahan langsung lewat ponsel.
  4. Bagan Eliminasi Otomatis: Sistem langsung membuat bagan aduan sesuai pemeringkatan kualifikasi.
  5. Hasil Akhir & E-Sertifikat: Publikasi papan klasemen final dan cetak e-sertifikat resmi berverifikasi.

Begitu babak kualifikasi selesai dan skor dikunci, sistem langsung menyusun bagan tanding eliminasi sesuai peringkat. Anda tidak perlu repot menghitung ranking atau menggambar bagan tanding di kertas lagi.

3. Tipe Akun dan Hak Akses

Di Archeris, setiap orang punya halaman dashboard yang sesuai dengan perannya:

  • Panitia Turnamen (Organizer): Buka pendaftaran, atur divisi lomba, pantau pembayaran, bagi nomor bantalan, dan kontrol skoring langsung dari Dashboard Organizer.
  • Pemanah (Archer): Simpan data profil (divisi busur, klub), daftar lomba dalam 1 klik tanpa isi ulang data, cek nomor target, dan unduh sertifikat resmi.
  • Pelatih & Pengurus Klub: Daftarkan rombongan atlet klub sekaligus dalam 1 kali bayar, pantau pembayaran tim, dan pantau skor atlet binaan secara live.
  • Petugas Skor Lapangan (Scorekeeper): Buka lembar skor bantalan pakai kode akses 5 huruf/angka tanpa perlu login atau instal aplikasi apa pun.

Dengan pembagian peran ini, petugas lapangan hanya fokus mencatat nilai panah, sementara panitia turnamen tetap memegang kendali penuh atas jalannya event.

4. Beda Cara Manual vs Pakai Archeris

Berikut perbandingan langsung antara menjalankan turnamen secara manual dibandingkan memakai platform Archeris:

Tahapan Lomba Cara Tradisional Dengan Platform Archeris
Pendaftaran & Pembayaran Google Form manual, kirim struk lewat WhatsApp, cek mutasi bank manual Portal pendaftaran online mandiri dengan verifikasi otomatis
Pembagian Bantalan Rumus Excel manual yang rawan bentrok nomor sasaran pemanah Alokasi bantalan otomatis 1-klik dilengkapi lembar cetak sasaran
Pencatatan Skor Kertas skor dikumpulkan tiap sesi lalu diketik ulang ke komputer sekretariat Input nilai langsung di samping bantalan sasaran lewat ponsel juri
Bagan Eliminasi Butuh waktu lama menghitung tie-break dan menggambar bagan tanding Bagan aduan terbentuk otomatis sesuai pemeringkatan kualifikasi
Publikasi Hasil & Piagam Papan pengumuman kertas dan piagam fisik yang butuh berminggu-minggu Papan klasemen live online dan e-sertifikat berverifikasi langsung unduh

Dengan sistem yang serba otomatis, panitia bisa lebih tenang dan fokus memastikan jalannya pertandingan di lapangan berlangsung aman dan tepat waktu.

5. Cara Memulai di Archeris

Memulai langkah di Archeris sangat mudah dan bisa dicoba kapan saja:

  1. Kalau Anda seorang Atlet: Buat akun gratis, lengkapi profil atlet (divisi busur, tangan dominan, klub), lalu pilih turnamen yang sedang buka pendaftaran.
  2. Kalau Anda Panitia Turnamen: Buat akun organizer, lengkapi profil klub atau organisasi Anda, lalu klik Buat Turnamen untuk meluncurkan event pertama Anda.

Anda juga bisa mencoba fitur skoring dan pembuatan bagan secara gratis kapan saja untuk latihan bersama tim lapangan sebelum hari perlombaan.
